title: 推导提示：一种基于逻辑的检索增强生成改进方法
summary: 提出Derivation Prompting，一种受逻辑推导启发的新提示技术，用于RAG生成步骤。通过系统应用预定义规则从初始假设推导结论，构建可解释的推导树以增强生成控制。在案例研究中显著减少了不可接受答案。
summary_en: Introduces Derivation Prompting, a novel logic-inspired prompting technique for the RAG generation step. It constructs an interpretable derivation tree by applying predefined rules, adding control over generation. A case study shows significant reduction in unacceptable answers compared to traditional RAG and long-context methods.
